name: Reality Inception Painting
shortDescription: A surreal painting inspired by René Magritte’s The Son of Man and The Key to the Fields, featuring red curtains, a shattered window, and a canvas viewed from the artist’s perspective.
description: This painting draws inspiration from René Magritte’s The Son of Man (1964) and The Key to the Fields (La clef des champs). It combines elements of both works into a scene painted on a handmade canvas.

Red curtains frame both sides of the composition. A shattered window and a canvas positioned in front of it create a layered perspective, as though the artist is standing to the right of the viewer’s point of view.

details.Inspiration: René Magritte — The Son of Man (1964) and The Key to the Fields
details.Composition: Red curtains, shattered window, and foreground canvas
